## Mitchells Plain Festival

Article and photos AB Sello Matloga; journalist at Navy News

itchells Plain Festival is an annual spectacular funM filled family event where the SA National Defence Force (SANDF) an opportunity to display its hardware and inform the public about its mandate: gets

This annual event was with a wide variety of activities for the whole family, including food stalls packed

<!-- image -->

and information centres. The took off with military displays by 9 SA Infantry Battalion (SA Army) demonstrating counter-attack tactics with smoke grenades and rifle shooting to the amazement of the learners from the surrounding primary schools first day definite favourite for many curious families. The public was amazed by the fire power of the SA which had weapons and tanks on display: Army Most young people and parents were interested in the SIYANDIZA Programme of the SA Air Force: SIYANDIZA aims to develop learners through the orientation programmes of the SA Air Force and draws special attention to possible careers in aviation.

The Human Resources Section offered information on careers in the SANDF which included specialised avionics, combat; engineering, maritime, technical, ABOVE: The Lynx helicopter of the SA Navy on display was a show stopper a definite favourite for many curious families.

<!-- image -->

LEFT: Curious little minds visiting the information stall of the SANDF

military health occupations and electronics. Informative materials were on display as part of the recruitment drive that aimed to rejuvenate the organisation with educated and fit young patriots.

One of the parents at the Mitchells Plain Festival, Ms Melisa Sergrys, said: "Ihad so much fun my boys loved all the military vehicles and the air show was my favourite. Thank you so for an awesome vibe. It was my first time and I will definitely not miss it ever much again'

Members of the SA Unit displayed the agility and tactics of their well trained while the SA Precision Drill Squad captivated the with their moves. The Lynx helicopter of the SA on display was a show stopper Navy Dog dogs Navy public quick Navy
